jobs.title: 产品研发工程师（车身、座椅系统方向） Product Development Engineer (Body, Seat System)
jobs.description_raw:
岗位职责Roles & Responsibilities：
•	负责整车车身结构、车身外饰、或者座舱座椅系统(座椅结构、舒适性、整椅系统)等整车部件的设计与开发，并负责相关领域的碰撞安全性能达成与新型材料的应用；
Responsible for the design and development of vehicle components, such as body structure, body exterior parts, or cabin seating systems (including seat structure, seat assembly, seat comfort and system control. etc), ensure the delivery of crash safety performance and drive the application of advanced materials.
•	与造型设计团队、人机工程团队、制造团队、市场团队等跨部门协同合作，创造兼具美观、舒适与实用性的产品方案，并确保符合全球安全法规及全球用户需求。
Collaborate with styling, ergonomics, manufacturing, marketing etc teams to create solutions that are visually appealing, comfortable, and practical, ensuring compliance with global safety regulations and meet global customer needs.
•	负责从概念设计到量产的端到端开发过程，确保整车部件按时交付，并达成卓越的质量与成本目标。
Responsible for the end-to-end development process from concept to production, ensuring vehicle components are delivered on time and meet excellent quality and cost targets.
•	主导供应商管理，推动先进技术落地，确保所开发部件的高质量与优越性能。
Lead supplier management, driving the implementation of advanced technologies to ensure the high quality and superior performance of developed components.
•	与电气、底盘及制造等其他工程团队紧密协作，确保车身结构、外饰、座舱硬件系统与整车完美融合。
Work closely with other engineering teams (e.g., electrical, chassis, manufacturing etc) to ensure seamless integration of body structures, exteriors, seating hardware systems with the rest of the vehicle.
•	负责产品的实验测试、质量验证和问题解决，确保所开发产品的长期耐用性与极致可靠性。
Responsible in testing, quality checks, and problem-solving to ensure the long-term durability and extreme reliability of the vehicle parts developed.

任职要求Qualifications & Skills Required:
•	本科及以上学历，工程或设计相关专业，包括但不限于车辆工程、机械工程、材料科学、工业设计、电气或电子工程。
Bachelor's Degree or above in Engineering or Design, including but not limited to Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Design, Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
•	具备机械结构、材料特性或人机工程学的基础知识，对汽车硬件设计充满热情。
Basic understanding of mechanical structures, material properties, or ergonomics, with a strong passion for vehicle hardware design.
•	熟悉计算机辅助设计（CAD）软件或三维/二维建模工具。
Familiarity with computer-aided design (CAD) software or 3D/2D modelling tools.
•	具备出色的逻辑分析、解决问题的能力以及对工程细节的敏锐关注。
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to engineering details.
•	优秀的中文和英文书面及口语沟通能力，具备良好的跨部门团队合作精神。
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Chinese and English, with a strong spirit of cross-functional teamwork.
•	渴望学习汽车行业的前沿技术，拥抱创新，并乐于应对快速发展的行业挑战。
Eagerness to learn cutting-edge technologies in the automotive industry, embrace innovations, and adapt to challenges in a fast-paced environment.
•	具备强烈的责任心和主人翁精神，面对挑战始终保持积极进取的解决问题态度。 
Strong sense of ownership, with a proactive "can-do" attitude when facing challenges

jobs.title: 产品体验分析师（座舱） Product Experience Analyst (Cockpit)
jobs.description_raw:
岗位职责Roles & Responsibilities：

1. 协助开展整车/座舱产品体验目标设定，参与梳理体验需求清单，支撑体验测例开发。

1. Assist in setting vehicle/cockpit product experience targets, help organize experience requirement lists, and support experience test case development.

2. 参与整车体验评估体系搭建与执行，协助完成实车体验评估、数据记录与报告输出。

2. Participate in building and executing the vehicle experience evaluation system; assist with in-vehicle experience evaluations, data recording, and report output.

3. 协助产品NPS问卷的发布、回收与数据分析，支撑问卷全流程运转。

3. Support the release, collection, and data analysis of product NPS surveys throughout the full process.

4. 收集、整理用户反馈、市场及竞品信息，协助产出用户/市场洞察结论，支撑产品决策。

4. Collect and organize user feedback, market and competitor information; assist in producing user/market insight conclusions to support product decisions.

5. 借助AI工具及数据分析方法，跟踪行业技术趋势与新品动态，协助新品发布看板及洞察数据库、研报资料的维护、归档与沉淀。

5. Use AI tools and data analysis methods to track industry technology trends and new product updates; help maintain the new product launch dashboard as well as organize, archive, and consolidate the insight database and research reports.

6. 协助撰写产品体验需求文档（PRD）及相关定义文档，配合跨部门沟通协调。

6. Assist in writing product experience requirement documents (PRD) and related definition documents, and support cross-department communication.




任职要求Qualifications & Skills Required:

Education & major requirement 学历及专业要求

1. 本科及以上学历；数据分析、汽车工程、自动化、计算机、统计学等理工科相关专业优先，跨专业多学位优先。

2026 fresh graduate, bachelor's degree or above; majors in data analysis, automotive engineering, automation, computer science, statistics or other STEM-related fields preferred; multiple degrees across majors are a plus.

2. 对汽车产品及用户体验充满热情，具备用户思维，参与过用户调研/社会实践项目优先。

Passionate about automotive products and user experience, with a user-centric mindset; experience in user research or related projects preferred.

3. 具备数据分析能力，熟悉AI编程或其他统计方法（如Python/SQL/R等）。

Data analysis capability, familiar with AI programming or other statistical methods (e.g., Python/SQL/R).

4. 学习能力强，逻辑清晰，能够快速适应岗位要求，积极拥抱变化。

Strong learning ability and logical thinking, able to quickly adapt to job requirements and embrace change.

5. 具备良好的沟通表达与团队协作能力，做事细致、责任心强。

Good communication and teamwork skills, detail-oriented and responsible.

6. 具备英文读写能力。

English reading and writing skills.

jobs.title: 财务毕业培训生（会计） Finance Graduate Trainee (Accounting)
jobs.description_raw:
岗位职责Roles & Responsibilities：

•	基础账务处理：协助整理日常发票、收据等原始凭证，按照规范格式录入会计系统，确保数据准确无误（Assist in organizing daily original documents such as invoices and receipts, and input data into the accounting system in accordance with standard formats to ensure data accuracy）。

•	费用报销协助：核对员工费用报销单据的完整性与合规性，指引同事补充缺失材料，配合完成报销流程（Verify the completeness and compliance of employees' expense reimbursement documents, guide colleagues to supplement missing materials, and cooperate in completing the reimbursement process）。

•	财务数据整理：按要求统计月度、季度基础财务数据，形成简单报表初稿，供上级进一步审核（Count monthly and quarterly basic financial data as required, and form a preliminary draft of simple reports for superiors to further review）。

•	档案管理支持：负责会计凭证、报表等财务资料的分类、装订与保管，确保档案整洁可查（Be responsible for the classification, binding and storage of financial materials such as accounting vouchers and reports to ensure files are neat and accessible）。

•	银行与税务辅助：协助完成银行回单领取、对账单核对等基础工作，配合处理发票开具、税务申报相关的辅助事务（Assist in completing basic work such as collecting bank receipts and checking bank statements, and cooperate in handling auxiliary matters related to invoice issuance and tax declaration）。

•	部门协作配合：响应其他部门的基础财务咨询，配合完成上级交办的其他临时性财务辅助任务（Respond to basic financial consultations from other departments and cooperate in completing other temporary financial auxiliary tasks assigned by superiors）。




任职要求Qualifications & Skills Required:

•	学历与专业：本科及以上学历，会计学、财务管理、审计学等财务相关专业应届毕业生（Bachelor's degree or above, fresh graduate majoring in accounting, financial management, auditing and other finance-related majors）。

•	知识基础：掌握基础会计理论知识，了解基本财务法规，熟悉 Excel 等办公软件基础操作（Master basic accounting theory knowledge, understand basic financial regulations, and be familiar with basic operations of office software such as Excel）。

•	能力要求：具备细心、耐心的工作态度，对数字敏感，能准确处理基础数据；有良好的沟通能力，可清晰对接同事与上级；学习能力强，愿意主动了解财务实际工作流程（Have a careful and patient work attitude, be sensitive to numbers, and can accurately process basic data; have good communication skills to clearly connect with colleagues and superiors; have strong learning ability and be willing to actively understand the actual financial work process）。
